exactDecisionText: D5 ADP Pricing Authority — FOUNDER_LOCKED. CORE: For the next 90 days, the current ADP market-test commercial configuration is $3,500 PER MONTH FOR 2 HOTELS (equivalent $1,750 PER HOTEL PER MONTH). Current quoted pilot structure: 6 MONTHS. Equivalent total for the current two-hotel configuration: $21,000. Pricing authority class: CURRENT MARKET-TEST DEFAULT (MARKET_TEST_DEFAULT). It is NOT APPROVED PERMANENT STANDARD LIST PRICE (APPROVED_STANDARD). PURPOSE: Near-term objective is not to maximize ARPU. Balance low-friction adoption, real paid validation, owner participation, real product usage, proof creation, recurring-use learning, revenue, hotel coverage, and pilot-to-recurring conversion. ADP should not be free by default (meaningful delivery cost; standalone client value; paid validation strategically important). Pricing should not become a barrier to acquiring qualified early users. WHEN HELENA MAY USE THIS PRICE: Helena may use $3,500/month for 2 hotels as the CURRENT MARKET-TEST DEFAULT in PREPARE workflows for a reasonably comparable hotel/owner pilot. Helena must label it accurately as MARKET-TEST PRICING or CURRENT PILOT PRICING. Helena may prepare material using this configuration without asking Joan to re-decide the base number every time. Helena still may NOT externally send or finalize the proposal without the applicable Joan approval. SIX-MONTH PILOT: Current market-test structure uses a six-month pilot to establish baseline, observe movement over time, create longitudinal AI visibility history, learn which actions matter, and create enough observation history to assess recurring value. Treat six months as CURRENT MARKET-TEST PILOT STRUCTURE — not a permanent universal contract term. CONFIGURATIONS REQUIRING JOAN REVIEW (CUSTOM_FOUNDER_REVIEW until separately approved): 1 hotel; 3+ hotels; large portfolios; brand enterprise programs; operator enterprise programs; regional/global portfolios; white-label arrangements; unusual service intensity; materially different data/research requirements; discounted pilots; free pilots; custom implementation; annual enterprise contracts. ONE-HOTEL RULE: Per D4, a client does NOT need two hotels to qualify for ADP — a one-hotel opportunity may be commercially valid. D5 does NOT authorize Helena to automatically calculate $1,750/month as standard one-hotel price. $1,750 is the arithmetic equivalent inside the two-hotel market-test quote, not an approved standalone one-hotel SKU. One-hotel pricing requires Joan review until separately locked. BRAND / OPERATOR / ENTERPRISE RULE: Brands and operators are active ADP commercial audiences under D3/D4, but $3,500/month for 2 hotels must NOT be extrapolated mechanically into brand portfolio pricing, operator portfolio pricing, enterprise tier pricing, or global pricing. Enterprise ADP pricing remains OPEN / CASE-BY-CASE (ENTERPRISE_TBD). Helena may prepare pricing strategy recommendations; Helena may not invent or quote enterprise pricing as approved. PRICING TAXONOMY for Operating Law v1: HISTORICAL; ILLUSTRATIVE; MARKET_TEST_DEFAULT; APPROVED_STANDARD; CUSTOM_FOUNDER_REVIEW; ENTERPRISE_TBD. INVESTMENT HURDLE ≠ ROI: FAQ illustration (~$250 ADR, ~70% rooms contribution margin, ≈10 incremental room nights per hotel/month) is INVESTMENT HURDLE / ECONOMIC CONTEXT ILLUSTRATION only — NOT proven ROI, guaranteed booking lift, guaranteed revenue impact, or proof ADP pays for itself. Helena must not convert this into an ROI claim. CURRENT ADP CLAIM DISCIPLINE — may credibly say: understand how a hotel appears in AI-generated answers; track visibility over time; identify demand-segment representation; compare competitor visibility; examine source/narrative patterns; identify potential actions; build longitudinal observation history. Must NOT currently promise: guaranteed ranking improvement; guaranteed bookings; guaranteed revenue lift; guaranteed direct-booking impact. FUTURE PRICING LEARNING: Helena should eventually analyze close rate, objections, willingness to pay, delivery cost, analyst/research load, gross margin, hotel count, portfolio size, pilot completion, pilot-to-recurring conversion, retention, value of benchmarking, customer type. Pricing should evolve from evidence — not solely intuition or one quoted deal. THIS LOCK DOES NOT DECIDE: permanent ADP list price; permanent one-hotel SKU; enterprise brand pricing; enterprise operator pricing; portfolio discounts; annual subscription pricing; final post-pilot recurring pricing; success-fee economics for selection; permanent contract duration; automatic discount authority; autonomous Helena pricing decisions.
